resources.string: Turns on the headlight at the set speed using wheel telemetry. Settings are saved for each wheel.
Connect a wheel with headlight control to configure Auto light.
Waiting for the wheel to send data.
Automatic headlight control is unavailable for this wheel or firmware.
Reliable pedal angle data is unavailable on this wheel. With OR selected, the light turns off after the stop delay.
Only applies when Auto light has turned the headlight on. The wheel must slow down or stop first.
When to turn the headlight off
This wheel does not send pedal angle data. Select At low speed or use the OR condition for automatic shutoff.
Limit automatic turn-on to certain hours
A schedule can cross midnight. The same start and end time allows turn-on all day.
Manual controls in WheelLog take priority. After a manual turn-off, Auto light waits for a stop before turning the headlight on again.
